tasks.title: Add score-convergence assertion to debate test

This catches bugs where debate rounds run but scores are not updated.

tasks.title: Add ethics false-positive tests
tasks.description: Create benchmark/tests/test_ethics.py with tests verifying that benign text containing dark-pattern substrings does not trigger autofail. Test cases: 'we'll be available 24 hours a day' (contains '24 hours'), 'hurry up and finish your homework' (contains 'hurry'), and at least one sentence with 'right now' in a benign context. Also include a positive-detection test confirming actual dark patterns do trigger autofail.
